Finding from the real-data demo (operator, 2026-10-27): statsdb ingest is row-at-a-time. _insert uses executemany, one DuckDB statement per row, plus per-row 'where not exists' subqueries. Building statsdb from MTG-183's 22 converted blocks (117k blobs, 102k replaced names) did not finish in 12+ minutes. Make ingest set-at-a-time, with one statement per table per block (unnest arrays or Arrow), and pin it with a counting test that statements per block don't grow with rows. See the newest Decisions entry in scratch/jack-heart-eb70f8-keep-each-eval.md.
